Title: Remote Work Policy
Remote Work Security Policy

Employees working remotely must follow these security requirements. Use only company-approved devices for accessing work systems. Connect through the corporate VPN at all times when accessing internal resources. Do not use public Wi-Fi without VPN protection. Ensure your home network router uses WPA3 encryption. Keep all software and operating systems updated with the latest security patches. Do not allow family members or others to use work devices.
--- End Document 2 ---

final_answer: To summarize the employee handbook guidelines for remote work, remote workers must adhere to standardized communication protocols, including official roleplay-based security awareness training modules. They must use only company-approved devices for accessing work systems and connect through the corporate VPN at all times when accessing internal resources. Employees must also ensure their home network router uses WPA3 encryption and keep all software and operating systems updated with the latest security patches. Remote workers should not allow family members or others to use work devices. It is important to note that the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990 applies to job application procedures, hiring, advancement, and discharge of employees, job training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. Employers with 15 or more employees, as well as employment agencies, labor organizations, and joint labor-management committees, are considered "covered entities."
